description.value: Kootenay Tamil Kitchen is a South Indian restaurant on Nelson's main commercial street, run by Tamil immigrants who cook authentic, family-heirloom recipes — heart-healthy dishes free of butter and cream. The operation has expanded to include an Indian grocery store across the street at 639 Baker St and a neighbourhood cafe (KTK Rosemont) at 1516 Crease Avenue. Chef Ciraj's background includes eight years on US cruise lines feeding thousands of guests, making this a genuinely accomplished kitchen in a small-town setting.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website confirms address (660 Baker St, Nelson, BC V1L 4J4) and phone (+1 778 463 1008) matching OSM. Takeout is explicitly confirmed via 'DINE IN OR TAKE OUT' and online ordering. No website content mentions bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or any other cycling amenities, so those remain null.
concerns: Business operates two additional related locations not captured in this OSM record: an Indian grocery/spice store at 639 Baker St and KTK Rosemont Market & Cafe at 1516 Crease Avenue — these may warrant separate OSM nodes and directory entries.
OSM cuisine tag is 'indian' but the restaurant is specifically South Indian / Tamil cuisine; the OSM tag could be made more precise.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active restaurant on Nelson's main street (Baker St) with dine-in and takeout; a clear food-and-drink stop for touring cyclists passing through the Kootenays.
